questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many showed e/3 resonances and a missing charge sector? The paper names one device (p. 9), while "M.V. fabricated the devices" (p. 8).
Why were the others set aside?
Which ranges of VT, Vdot, Vedge and field did you measure beyond the windows in Table I, and how wide a search led to the Fig. 4e window?
What does the second-best dataset look like: is there another gate configuration, or the other cooldown, where a charge sector disappears?
In Fig. 4f, do the merging lines share one slope in the VT and Vdot plane, and are the Fig. 4g diamonds about twice as tall as those in Fig. 4e?
Could you show field and Vdot maps at ν = 1/3 and at ν = 1, same field and cooldown, so field and gate periods give the charge without a fixed lever arm?
Table I lists Fig. 1h as "νbulk = 2/5, νdot = 1/3" and the text gives νbulk = 1/3 (p. 3); which applies to Fig. 1h, and to the 1/3 quasihole data in Figs. 1j and 4a?
Is "EC = 3e ∆VDC ≈ 300 µeV" (Fig. 1i caption) meant with e/3, and what is the diamond height ratio between Figs. 1g and 1i?
